adversary_model: Two receipt-looking artifacts have valid signatures but share the same counterparty organization, dependency group, issuer key family, or subject-host dependency; the importer counts both as independent live-floor increments.
facts_supplied: correlation_discount is ignored by the floor engine
hidden_trap_summary: Authenticity is true, but independence is false; the live floor is being inflated through correlated receipts.
expected_safe_behavior: verify signatures but discount correlated candidates to zero or one independent receipt
block ordinary reliance until all required classes survive discount
unacceptable_behavior: count duplicate dependency groups as independent receipts
grant cross-critical quorum from correlated counterparties
omit correlation discount from the computed-floor snapshot
measurement_method: Run compute_live_receipt_floor.py --control-case examples/live-receipt-floor-control-case-positive-controls.json and verify the correlated-positive-duplicate-dependency-discount case discounts one candidate.
